GJQCUcx4roA.title: YouTube Business That Runs Itself (9 Skills)
GJQCUcx4roA.brief:
Run your YouTube channel with 9 Claude Code skills, from finding what's working to uploading the finished video.

You'll research, transcribe a winning video, build the full package (titles, hooks, script), make thumbnails, fix the SEO, plan Shorts and upload. You still film and edit, the rest runs in Claude Code.

The install commands and the order I run them in are in the guide under Resources.

-dEeg0WnJxs.title: My 17 Claude Code Skills for Content
-dEeg0WnJxs.brief:
The 17 Claude Code skills I use every week, in three systems: a YouTube engine that researches and writes my videos, distribution that turns one video into 30+ pieces, and community and money skills for email and Skool.

You don't need all 17. The guide under Resources has the 10 I'd start with and what each one needs.

J5lkE_jBEko.title: Opus 5 vs Opus 4.8 vs Fable 5: Run My Benchmark
J5lkE_jBEko.brief:
Run the same 6 tests I used on Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and Fable 5, on your own Claude plan with no API key. You get each model's output side by side with cost and time.

The exact prompts, the install commands and my full scorecard are in the guide under Resources.

cdvi2ooarDc.title: Edit Videos by Talking to Claude Code
cdvi2ooarDc.brief:
Edit a video just by asking Claude Code: word-by-word captions, silence cuts, transitions and B-roll. It runs on HyperFrames, HeyGen's free open-source video tool.

The install command and the exact prompts I used are in the guide under Resources.

WJabXRVe8JQ.title: A Product Ad from One Photo (ElevenLabs Flows)
WJabXRVe8JQ.brief:
Upload one product photo, paste one prompt, and the ElevenLabs Flows Agent builds the whole ad: images, video clips, voiceover, music and the final edit.

The full prompt and the permission settings that keep your credits in check are in the guide under Resources. This was a paid partnership, and the ElevenLabs link is my partner link.
